xray_regional_debt_2021.title_th: X-ray หนี้ครัวเรือนภูมิภาค (Regional Letter ฉบับที่ 10/2564)
xray_regional_debt_2021.publisher: ธนาคารแห่งประเทศไทย ฝ่ายนโยบายโครงสร้างเศรษฐกิจ (BOT Structural Economic Policy Department)
xray_regional_debt_2021.authors: มนัสชัย จึงตระกูล, ศรันยา อิรนพไพบูลย์, วัชรพงศ์ รัชตเวชกุล, อนุสรา อนุวงค์
xray_regional_debt_2021.vintage: Regional Letter 10/2564 (2021); underlying data NSO SES 2552-2562 (2009-2019), cross-sectional cuts mostly at 2562 (2019)
xray_regional_debt_2021.method: text-layer PDF extraction via pdfplumber (not OCR — verified real text layer)
xray_regional_debt_2021.caveat: OLDER vintage (2019 cross-section) — this is the only BOT publication found with a genuine PROVINCE-level household-debt cut (vulnerable-household share by province, fig.10), so it is kept despite its age. Prefer the 2025 Northern Letter's region-level 2023 figures where both exist.

meta.region_definition: Both sources use BOT's 4-region household-debt split: ภาคกลาง (Central, INCLUDES Bangkok + its metro provinces — NOT the same as the 5-region admin split used elsewhere in this repo's regionmap.py, which separates Bangkok from Central), ภาคเหนือ (North), ภาคอีสาน (Northeast), ภาคใต้ (South). Downstream joins against regionmap.py's region keys must account for this Bangkok-inside-Central difference.

parse_notes.method: Both PDFs downloaded via curl (Chrome UA) to source-data/raw/bot-hhdebt/, then text extracted page-by-page with pdfplumber (PYTHONUTF8=1). Every numeric value in series[] was matched against an explicit prose sentence in the extracted text (not inferred purely from chart bar/label left-to-right position) EXCEPT the two items explicitly marked confidence='medium' (vulnerable_household_livelihood/vehicle_debt_share, North, 2566), which were reconstructed from an infographic block with only partial prose confirmation.
unparseable_omitted: Northern Letter fig.3 (p.1): North debt-per-household bar chart for years 2554/2556/2558/2560/2564 (5 of 7 points) — pdfplumber returned the 7 bar values and 7 year labels in a jumbled order with only 2 of the 7 pairings confirmable via prose (2562=154,064 and 2566=182,968, both included above). The other 5 values were visible in the raw text (122481, 137188, 145367, 167438, 201724) but their year assignment could not be confirmed, so they were omitted rather than guessed.

Northern Letter fig.9-equiv (p.2): DSR-by-income-group chart had additional 'ครัวเรือนรายได้ปานกลาง' (middle-income) and cross-year (2562/2564/2566) DSR series visible in the raw text but with ambiguous label-to-value pairing beyond the 5 values already included (overall/low-income/agri/non-agri/vulnerable, all 2566) — omitted.

X-ray fig.6 (p.3): full 5-region x 6-purpose debt-composition pie-chart data (ประเทศ/กลาง/เหนือ/อีสาน/ใต้ x อุปโภคบริโภค/อื่นๆ/ธุรกิจ/เกษตร/ศึกษา/ที่อยู่อาศัย) — only the 4 cells independently confirmed by prose sentences were kept (South/Northeast consumption share, Northeast/Central housing share); the rest of the pie-chart matrix was left out.

X-ray fig.9 (p.4): 'สัดส่วนรายจ่ายไม่จำเป็นต่อรายจ่ายรวม' (non-essential spending share) for indebted vs non-indebted households x 5 regions (10 values) — no anchoring prose sentence gave an unambiguous region+group pairing for any individual value; omitted in full.

X-ray fig.10 (p.5): South region's own vulnerable-household-share value read as identical (10%) to the national baseline it was being contrasted against in the same sentence ('ภาคใต้...สูงกว่าค่าเฉลี่ยประเทศที่อยู่ในระดับ 10%') — internally inconsistent, so the South region-level figure was dropped (the 5 province-level values in the same figure were unambiguous and are included).

X-ray fig.12 (p.6): 5-region x 2-occupation-group (เกษตรกร / ผู้ไม่ได้ปฏิบัติงานเชิงเศรษฐกิจ) vulnerable-share chart — only the Northeast/non-econ-active cell (7%) is confirmed by prose; the other 9 cells were left out.

BOT statistics portal report FI_CB_011_S4 (เงินรับฝากและเงินให้สินเชื่อของธนาคารพาณิชย์จำแนกตามจังหวัด, https://app.bot.or.th/BTWS_STAT/statistics/BOTWEBSTAT.aspx?reportID=781&language=th) — genuine BOT province-level commercial-bank credit/deposit table (Jan 2013-Jun 2025, monthly, all 77 provinces) was located and its page downloaded (source-data/raw/bot-hhdebt/report781.html, 494KB) but NOT parsed: it is a .NET WebForms ASPX page whose data grid and Excel export are rendered via __doPostBack JS, not present as a static HTML table or a plain-GET-able export link — a plain curl GET returns only the page shell. Would need Playwright/browser automation to actually pull the table; not attempted this session (out of scope: it is ALL commercial-bank credit, not household-specific, so it's a secondary target even if unlocked).

No BOT-published Regional Letter equivalent to the Northern one (household debt, 2025 vintage) was found for the Northeast, South, or Central regions despite several targeted searches — only the North has a 2025-vintage regional deep-dive; the other 3 regions' most recent BOT-sourced regional cut remains the 2021 X-ray letter's 2019 cross-section.

BOT quarterly regional economic press releases (เศรษฐกิจการเงินภาคเหนือ/อีสาน/ใต้, newest checked: Northern Q1/2569) do NOT carry household-debt figures at all — confirmed by fetching the Northern Q1/2569 release; sectoral GDP-style indicators only. Not a usable source for this ingest.

PIER's household-debt dashboard (https://projects.pier.or.th/household-debt/, BOT-affiliated research institute, credit-bureau microdata) was checked — national aggregates only, no regional/provincial cut, no downloadable data — not usable.
